package.description: The official command-line interface for the Idira Identity Security Platform.

en-US.description: The official command-line interface for the Idira Identity Security Platform.
en-US.longDescription:
idsec is the official CLI for the Idira Identity Security Platform (formerly CyberArk,
now part of Palo Alto Networks). It lets administrators and automation authenticate and
manage identity security services — including Secure Infrastructure Access, Privilege Cloud,
Identity, Secrets Hub, and Secure Cloud Access — from the terminal or from scripts.
en-US.name: Idira CLI
